home.aboutBio: A licensed psychotherapist with over 10 years of experience providing individual and couples counseling. I rely on cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and mindfulness techniques to help individuals understand themselves more deeply and develop healthy ways of coping with life's pressures. I believe in offering a safe, judgment-free environment to support your journey toward recovery.
home.heroSubtitle:
We help you overcome psychological difficulties
and reach a balanced, mindful life.
